flat-sticker.fragment: Flat vector t-shirt graphic on a plain white background. Clean, crisp, flat colors, no gradients, no shading, no drop shadow, sticker-style screen-print design.

vintage-road-sign.fragment: Vintage weathered highway warning sign graphic on a plain white background. Aged 1970s screen-print look, slightly distressed paint, subtle print wear and chipping at the edges, faded but readable black lettering, muted retro yellow, flat colors, no gradients, no drop shadow.

woodcut.fragment: Bold black woodcut / linocut print graphic on a plain white background. Carved relief-print style, thick expressive black lines, visible gouge marks and ink-stamped texture, small amount of printed ink noise, no gray tones, no drop shadow, strong contrast.

risograph.fragment: Risograph print graphic on a plain white background. Limited 2-3 color palette, visible paper grain, slight ink misregistration offset, flat layered colors, no gradients, no drop shadow, zine-style print texture.

serigraph-poster.fragment: Bold serigraph / screen-print poster graphic on a plain white background. Limited flat palette, visible halftone dots in shading, thick even ink layers, slight ink bleed at edges, poster-art composition, no gradients, no drop shadow.

minimal-line.fragment: Minimalist thin line-art graphic on a plain white background. Single-weight fine black lines, generous negative space, no fills except one accent color (e.g. the sign's yellow), no shading, no gradients, no drop shadow, elegant simple composition.

comic-ink.fragment: Bold comic-book ink graphic on a plain white background. Thick confident ink outlines, halftone-dot shading, slightly exaggerated shapes, dynamic line weight, flat colors, no gradients, no drop shadow.

childrens-watercolor.fragment: Soft children's book watercolor illustration. Gentle hand-painted wash textures, warm friendly palette, soft edges, subtle paper texture, no harsh outlines, no gradients banding, charming and approachable.

neon-night.fragment: Glowing neon tube sign at night. Bright saturated glowing outlines in neon colors, dark charcoal background, soft glow bloom around the tubes, subtle reflection, high contrast.

midcentury-atomic.fragment: Mid-century atomic-age graphic on a plain white background. Retro googie shapes, bold rounded forms, two-tone color blocking, starburst accents, flat mid-century palette (cream, mustard, teal, brick), no gradients, no drop shadow.
